author: devbig030
body: Detector soundness, measured on feat/scxsim-cratesio-release-candidate: as mutation M4 (of four used to test symbol_export.rs), the sim_deterministic_mem.c definitions were given hidden visibility. known_gap_libc_takes_the_so_memory_functions then went red, as it should: the known-gap test fires when the fix sketched above is applied, so its red is trustworthy. The mutation was reverted; the arena-headroom and cross-allocator checks in the fix sketch were NOT done and still gate a real fix.
